mentions.name: Bilingual lease termination letter generator
mentions.description: A bilingual tool that generates lease termination letters. The templates can be verified by lawyers to guarantee the resulting letters are legally compliant, so the hard work only needs to be done once and then benefits everyone.
mentions.problem: Producing a legally compliant lease termination letter requires hard work that, once done and lawyer-verified, can benefit everyone.
